title: The Goa Public Lighting Duty Act, 2021
full_text: The Goa Public Lighting Duty Act, 2021 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202125 Act Number: 25 Enactment Date: 2021-07-30 Act Year: 2021 Short Title: The Goa Public Lighting Duty Act, 2021 Long Title: To provide for the levy and collection of public lighting duty on the electricity consumers in the State of Goa so as to create new infrastructure for public lighting and to operate and maintain public lighting owned by Electricity Department and other Government Departments in the entire State of Goa and for the matters connected therewith and incidental thereto.
